title: Agent record (Target Registry, architecture-change-04)
$comment: @akili-spec changes/cicd-executor-poc architecture-change-04 §5, §11.4. One item of cicd-registry-<stage> (AGENT#{agentId} / META), validated without its key attributes. Written only by the administrative tool, read by the Executor with GetItem. roleId is the agent role's unique id, compared with the role-id prefix of the SQS SenderId of every agent event (AG-D8); commandQueueUrl is where the Executor sends this agent's commands; targets lists the targetIds this agent may serve (an event about any other target is refused). Values are non-secret; never committed (DD-23).

stage.$comment: Platform stage (AP-4: one agent per server and platform stage).

roleId.$comment: Unique id of the agent's IAM role (never an ARN, never a credential).
